#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() {}
    
    class FastInput {
    private:
        const int BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 15;
        unsigned char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
        int pos, size;
        FILE* stream;
        
    public:
        FastInput(FILE* f) : stream(f) {
            pos = 0;
            size = 0;
        }
        
        int fetch() {
            if (pos >= size) {
                size = fread(buffer, 1, BUFFER_SIZE, stream);
                pos = 0;
                if (size <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[pos++];
        }
        
        int nextInt() {
            int ch;
            while ((ch = fetch()) <= 32) if (ch == -1) return -1;
            int num = 0;
            while (ch > 32) {
                num = num * 10 + ch - '0';
                ch = fetch();
            }
            return num;
        }
    };
    
    FastInput* in;
    
    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    vector<vector<int>> graph;
    int nodeCount, edgeCount;
    vector<int> potential, level, prevEdge;
    vector<int> src, dst, xorEdge, weight;
    vector<int> capacity;
    
    void setup(int n, int m) {
        graph.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) graph[i].clear();
        potential.assign(n, INF);
        level.assign(n, 0);
        prevEdge.assign(n, 0);
        src.resize(m);
        dst.resize(m);
        xorEdge.resize(m);
        weight.resize(m);
        capacity.assign(m * 2, 0);
        edgeCount = 0;
    }
    
    void link(int u, int v, int cap, int c) {
        int idx = edgeCount++;
        src[idx] = u;
        dst[idx] = v;
        xorEdge[idx] = u ^ v;
        weight[idx] = c;
        capacity[idx * 2] = cap;
        graph[u].push_back(idx * 2);
        graph[v].push_back(idx * 2 + 1);
    }
    
    vector<int> queue;
    int queueStart, queueEnd, queueLength;
    vector<bool> inQueue;
    
    void offer(int v) {
        if (inQueue[v]) return;
        if (queueStart + queueEnd == (int)queue.size()) {
            if (queueLength * 2 <= (int)queue.size()) {
                copy(queue.begin() + queueStart, queue.begin() + queueStart + queueLength, queue.begin());
            } else {
                vector<int> newQueue(queue.size() * 2);
                copy(queue.begin() + queueStart, queue.begin() + queueStart + queueLength, newQueue.begin());
                queue = newQueue;
            }
            queueStart = 0;
        }
        queue[queueStart + queueEnd++] = v;
        inQueue[v] = true;
    }
    
    int poll() {
        int v = queue[queueStart++];
        queueLength--;
        inQueue[v] = false;
        return v;
    }
    
    bool findPath(int source, int sink) {
        fill(potential.begin(), potential.end(), INF);
        potential[source] = 0;
        queueStart = queueEnd = 0;
        offer(source);
        
        while (queueLength > 0) {
            int u = poll();
            int newLevel = level[u] + 1;
            
            for (int edge : graph[u]) {
                if (capacity[edge] > 0) {
                    int idx = edge >> 1;
                    int c = (edge & 1) == 0 ? weight[idx] : -weight[idx];
                    int newPotential = potential[u] + c;
                    int v = u ^ xorEdge[idx];
                    
                    if (potential[v] > newPotential || 
                        (potential[v] == newPotential && level[v] > newLevel)) {
                        potential[v] = newPotential;
                        level[v] = newLevel;
                        prevEdge[v] = edge;
                        offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return potential[sink] != INF;
    }
    
    void augment(int source, int sink) {
        int minCap = INF;
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v ^= xorEdge[prevEdge[v] >> 1]) {
            minCap = min(minCap, capacity[prevEdge[v]]);
        }
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v ^= xorEdge[prevEdge[v] >> 1]) {
            int e = prevEdge[v];
            capacity[e] -= minCap;
            capacity[e ^ 1] += minCap;
        }
    }
    
    void augmentUnit(int source, int sink) {
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v ^= xorEdge[prevEdge[v] >> 1]) {
            int e = prevEdge[v];
            capacity[e]--;
            capacity[e ^ 1]++;
        }
    }
    
    int minCostMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        while (findPath(source, sink)) {
            augmentUnit(source, sink);
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < edgeCount; i++) {
            total += weight[i] * capacity[i * 2 + 1];
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    void run() {
        in = new FastInput(stdin);
        int n = in->nextInt();
        int m = in->nextInt();
        int k = in->nextInt();
        int c = in->nextInt();
        int d = in->nextInt();
        
        vector<int> special(k);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            special[i] = in->nextInt() - 1;
        }
        
        vector<vector<int>> g(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i].clear();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = in->nextInt() - 1;
            int v = in->nextInt() - 1;
            g[u].push_back(v);
            g[v].push_back(u);
        }
        
        int T = k + 1;
        int totalNodes = n * T + 1;
        int totalEdges = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (T - 1);
        
        setup(totalNodes, totalEdges);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * T + t;
                for (int neighbor : g[i]) {
                    int v = neighbor * T + t + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * T + t;
                int v = u + 1;
                link(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            link(totalNodes - 1, special[i] * T, 1, 0);
        }
        
        cout << minCostMaxFlow(totalNodes - 1, 0 * T + T - 1) << endl;
        
        delete in;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.run();
    return 0;
}
